youth.title: Submit this fictional profile for staff review — local development
paragraphs: Use made-up information only. With the checkbox selected, Submit profile saves your answers and sends this submission to the separately signed-in synthetic chairperson, treasurer and secretary in one server operation. No later Share button is needed. Save draft remains private.

If you agree, the separately signed-in synthetic chairperson, treasurer and secretary have equal permission to read this submission and record one review outcome. Their private list shows your fictional name, internal record reference, submission time and synthetic review status. Selected detail includes all saved profiling answers, including fictional contact, address, RBI, family, disability and other personal claims. Private workload counts include submissions shared this way and their outcomes.

One of these staff members may record Approved, Needs changes or Rejected. Needs changes and Rejected require a note. You can see your own saved outcome, note and attributed history after signing in again. Needs changes is a saved request only: editing/resubmitting submitted answers is unavailable. Completed decisions cannot be reopened or changed in this version.

All three authorized staff can see the shared activity for supported work: the actual staff display label and position, action, internal record reference, outcome and server-recorded time. Review activity is saved with the decision. Full answers and decision notes are not included in that activity feed; authorized selected detail remains private. Your Auth account identifier is not displayed in the feed.

Approved remains a synthetic software-review outcome, not proof of identity, residency, eligibility or official KK registration. Equal business access does not grant infrastructure administration, arbitrary answer editing/deletion, account-link approval or public publication. The fictional practice login grants no database authority. Finance/events actions need their owners' separate backend rules; your youth answers are not made public or copied into another subsystem by this permission.

The server records your account, this notice version and acknowledgment time, and records each decision's authenticated staff actor, historical display label/position and server time. Stored data remains after reload or sign-out. Trusted development/database operators can access it. General retention, deletion and withdrawal procedures remain unresolved: there is no owner withdrawal/deletion control or promised deletion date. Separately generated demo batches can later be intentionally removed by trusted local maintenance; minimized staff activity and cleanup accountability remain. This is not permission to remove your manually created record.

Disabling or revoking staff access stops future checked requests but cannot erase previously viewed/copied data. Acknowledgment is not proof of reading or identity. This is local synthetic development, not real-person collection, official registration or public demographics.

For approved submissions acknowledged under this notice, these same three staff may use minimized private profile data for the existing registry and aggregate planning charts/reports: age group, gender, civil status, education, work/OSY status, civic answers, organization presence and coded program-interest categories. Raw free-text suggestions, names, contact details, addresses, RBI, family and disability detail are excluded from the Analytics dataset. The registry keeps its bounded six-column approved roster export. Private reports are not public demographics.
The server retains the existing review-permission receipt and this additional submission-time notice receipt. Existing unshared records are not converted or shared automatically.
youth.checkbox: I agree to submit these fictional answers directly to the three-person staff review queue, including one attributed outcome/note, minimized shared activity and the private registry/Analytics uses described above.

encoder.title: Fictional staff-encoded walk-in profile — local development only
paragraphs: Enter made-up examples only. This form is not approved for collecting information about real people, including real walk-in youth or guardians.

You are the authenticated staff encoder, not the youth account owner. The server records your historical staff label/position, this attestation version and the actual save time. It does not create a youth login, account link or receipt claiming that a youth or guardian personally consented. The legacy certification field records validation of this fictional example, not a participant signature.

The synthetic chairperson, treasurer and secretary may equally read the saved fictional answers, record one Approved, Needs changes or Rejected outcome and view attributed review activity. Approved examples may feed minimized private Analytics and the existing six-column roster. Full answers remain selected-detail only; actual review notes are excluded from Analytics/activity. Encoding is shown through its selected immutable encoder receipt; the shared feed currently records supported Auth and review decisions, not a fabricated profile-created event.

Save is immediately queued for staff review. A repeated save with the same retry ID and identical answers returns the original; changed answers conflict. This does not identify duplicate people, approve account links or verify identity/residency. General correction, withdrawal, deletion and retention procedures remain unresolved. Trusted local operators can access records; no deletion date is promised. Explicit tracked demo imports may later be removed while minimized review activity and cleanup accountability remain.
A genuine participant/guardian notice, acknowledgment method, evidence custody and authority for real collection remain unapproved and outside this synthetic form.
encoder.checkbox: I confirm this is a fictional example and I am recording my own staff-encoder attestation, not claiming consent or certification from a youth or guardian.
